Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Caller (Dark)|Caller]]: the cover of ''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'' (West End Games, 1991), a sourcebook for ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game''. Its equipment section lists the device as a "Restraining Bolt & Owner". Cover painting by Ralph McQuarrie.

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cracken%27s_Rebel_Field_Guide_(sourcebook) Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)], Wookieepedia (file Crackensrebelfieldguide.jpg). Reduced to 300 by 400 pixels. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260619100919/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cracken%27s_Rebel_Field_Guide_(sourcebook) Internet Archive], 19 June 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (300 by 400 pixels) of the cover of a 1991 book, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and West End Games, shown to identify the book the card's word "owners" also appears in. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
